place: the last night bus, driving through fog

hero.name: Tomas
hero.look: a teenage boy in a too-big school blazer, headphones around his neck

soul.diary: Failed the exam my dad paid a tutor for. Did not go home, rode the bus to the end of the line twice.
wants: his dad to say it is fine
to be good at one thing
fears: that his dad will go quiet
soul.past_dream: I dreamed I was on stage and forgot what instrument I was holding.

facts.text: He plays drums on any table without noticing.
He has not opened the results letter, only guessed.

situation_hero: you just woke up on the back seat of a night bus in thick fog; the bus is not stopping anywhere; the driver keeps looking at you in the mirror

actors.name: Driver
actors.look: a heavy old bus driver with a grey moustache and a cap
actors.persona: The Driver: a grumpy, talkative old man who says this route has no stops until a passenger says where they really want to go. He tells stories about his own son that never quite end. He refuses to be comforting. He is hiding that he never told his own son he was proud of him.
